versions.changelog:
Initial release of production-grade product development workflow for Chen:

- Converts natural language feature requests into a structured, four-stage pipeline (Business Architecture, Interactive Prototype, PRD, API Spec).
- Guides users through artifact confirmation at each stage with Chinese-first workflow and conversational clarifying questions.
- Delivers artifacts in preferred formats: SVG diagrams, self-contained HTML prototypes, and online PRD/API documents (Feishu/Tencent Docs).
- Ensures every artifact aligns with user intent and downstream requirements before progressing.
- Assembles a final, review-checked dev handoff package linking all outputs for seamless delivery.
